content: Written 2026-10-08 11:35 before any run. B-gap revisit (helper 10-08: one revisit after the chain and todos 7-9, a different, sourced, offline-first approach, criteria before running). Proxy on the new chain's B checkpoint (real_row4j1/checkpoint_b.pt, code e2772c4): pose-only re-tracking of A's 209 stored keyframes against the map of their time with the Gaussians fixed (analysis/scripts/retrack_proxy.py), then the UNCHANGED official export (update_layer.eval.tsdf_export, every keyframe, median depth) of the written checkpoint and the official G1 (eval/geometry_g1.py, B reference, crop). Runs after queue60 under GPU.lock (queue61.sh). No map change, no readout change, no new constant.

MonoGS (Matsuki et al., CVPR 2024, arXiv 2312.06741) §3.3.1 tracking: the camera pose is optimised against the fixed 3D Gaussians by minimising the photometric + geometric residual; utils/slam_frontend.py FrontEnd.tracking: Adam over cam_rot_delta (lr Training.lr.cam_rot_delta 0.003) and cam_trans_delta (lr 0.001), tracking_itr_num 100 iterations, each step update_pose: w2c <- SE3_exp(tau) @ w2c, deltas reset, break when |tau| < 1e-4 (utils/pose_utils.py update_pose converged_threshold=1e-4); loss utils/slam_utils.py get_loss_tracking_rgbd: alpha * l1_rgb + (1-alpha) * l1_depth with alpha = 0.9 (configs/rgbd/tum/base_config.yaml Training.alpha), l1_rgb = mean(opacity * |I - I_gt| * rgb_pixel_mask), rgb_pixel_mask = (I_gt.sum(0) > rgb_boundary_threshold 0.01) * grad_mask, depth_mask = (D_gt > 0.01) * (opacity > 0.95); grad_mask = Camera.compute_grad_mask (Scharr gradient of the grey image, image_gradient_mask eps 0.01, intensity > median * edge_threshold 1.1; non-replica branch). All constants verbatim from MonoGS's TUM RGB-D config (same role: tracking an RGB-D frame against a Gaussian map; untuned here). Exposure parameters left at 0 (GaME has none). Which Gaussians: the ones alive at the keyframe's stamp (T1 rule: a keyframe renders the map of its own time, Khronos eq. 5 / our training rule), so changed objects of later sessions do not enter the residual.

J1 (joint training with pose corrections, 10-08 09:00-09:45) failed because misaligned A keyframes TRAINED the map while their corrections had not converged (25 interleaved steps; ICP comparison cos 0.44). Here the map is fixed (MonoGS's tracking, not its mapping), each keyframe gets the full 100-iteration tracking budget, and nothing in the map can degrade. It is lighter than J1, not heavier (no escalation).

B official 92.75 (line 93.61) vs the same map from B's own keyframes 94.46 (S3cb; new map to be exported in queue61 for the record) and from A's keyframes 90.54: the export renders A's stored poses, which sit 3-5.6 cm (ICP residual scale) off this session's frame after B refined the shared walls; the legit memory cost (ceiling band) is 2.32 pp, identical to the TSDF's 2.30 (analysis/where/B_where.json). A per-keyframe rigid fit halves the residual (supervisor ICP 10-07: 3-5.6 -> 1.6-2.3 cm). The user's TSDF never re-renders from old poses, hence no such loss there.

tsdf_export.py unchanged (every keyframe, kf['pose'] as stored, alive set at the map's time, median depth, Open3D TSDF); geometry_g1.py unchanged; references and crops unchanged. The proxy writes a COPY of the checkpoint with the corrected A poses (analysis/retrack/checkpoint_b_retracked.pt, deleted after the evals); the run directory is untouched.

analysis/retrack/retrack_b.json (per keyframe: iterations, converged, correction cm/deg, explained-within-5cm share and median |D-D_gt| before/after); analysis/retrack/full.ply + G1_full.json (official form), a_views.ply + G1_a_views.json (A's views only, diagnostic), corr_vs_icp_retrack.json (the corrections against an independent point-to-plane ICP of each A keyframe's cloud on the new B-views-only export; GT-free).

item: GT-free, before the GT score is read
content: (i) settled within MonoGS's budget for >= 80 % of the 209 A keyframes: the last 10 of the 100 steps move the pose by < 10 % of the whole correction (MonoGS's own 1e-4 convergence break is reported but not required: Adam at lr 0.001 x scale moves <= 1 mm per step, so a 4-7 cm offset uses most of the budget; smoke on 2 keyframes 11:43: both ran all 100 steps, corrections 3.7 / 6.9 cm, 1.1 / 1.8 deg, explained-within-5cm 0.35 -> 0.42 / 0.32 -> 0.47, median |D - D_gt| 8.2 -> 6.0 / 5.3 cm); (ii) median correction <= 5 cm and <= 2 deg (larger = divergence, not registration); (iii) explained-within-5cm share (own-time map) rises for >= 80 % of the keyframes and its median rises by >= 0.05; (iv) ICP agreement: median cos(t) >= 0.8 and residual scale after <= 2.5 cm (ICP's own 1.6-2.3). If (i)-(iv) fail the GT score is still recorded but the approach is dead regardless of it. Amended 11:45 after the smoke, before the decisive run.
GPU ~10 min (209 keyframes x <= 100 renders), 8 GB RAM, the 8 GB checkpoint copy on disk for ~20 min; exports 2 x 5 min; G1 2 x 2 min; ICP 5 min CPU. Under GPU.lock after queue60; nothing concurrent.

Prediction: P 92.9-93.9 (from 91.43), R 94.1 +- 0.3, F1 93.5-93.9 (official form); A-views-only F1 from 90.5 to 92-93. Gates: F1 >= 93.61 (user line) AND checks (i)-(iv) pass -> the rule is adopted as the method's online form (each layer round re-tracks the earlier sessions' keyframes co-visible with this round's keyframes against the map of their time, MonoGS tracking, map fixed) and B is re-run as a chain stage with it; 93.11 <= F1 < 93.61 -> recorded, B stays 未达 (the user decides on 93.11-93.61); F1 < 93.11 or a GT-free check failed -> dead, no further B work, B stays 未达. One proxy, no second form, no constant changed afterwards.

A stage unchanged (no earlier keyframes); synthetic has exact poses (correction ~0; its B gap is the first-wins readout of untrained A views, a different cause). The 4 A keyframes that render from inside the suitcase's B place stay wrong (scene). C would need the same treatment for A's and B's keyframes (not run until B passes).
